messages: [04:43:44] [NPC] Kat: You can pick it up in §e29 minutes 55 seconds§f.
[04:43:47] [NPC] Kat: Stop by once it's done, okay?
[04:44:11] [NPC] Susan: §f§fHey, are you here to volunteer for the Safety Squad?
[04:44:12] Select an option: [Absolutely!] [Tell me more about the Safety Squad.] [Not right now.]
[04:44:13] [NPC] Susan: §f§fHey, are you here to volunteer for the Safety Squad?
[04:44:14] Select an option: [Absolutely!] [Tell me more about the Safety Squad.] [Not right now.]
[04:44:15] [NPC] Susan: §f§fGood heavens, that's great news!
[04:44:18] [NPC] Susan: §f§fWith dangerous activity running rampant recently, we could really use your help.
[04:44:23] [NPC] Susan: §f§fYou'll need to undergo some training to become a Safety Advocate.
[04:44:27] [NPC] Susan: §f§fIs this fine with you? I promise it won't take long.
[04:44:31] Select an option: [Sounds good with me!] [Give me a moment.]
[04:44:36] [NPC] Susan: §f§fProcessing your registration...
[04:44:39] [NPC] Susan: §f§fAwesome! You're our §c286218th §f§fvolunteer!
[04:44:43] [NPC] Susan: §f§fHead into the doorway next to me, she'll be waiting for you!
[04:46:58] [NPC] Susan: §f§fBrigette is waiting for you in the §bSecurity Hall§f. Better not keep her waiting!
[04:47:01] [NPC] Susan: §f§fBrigette is waiting for you in the §bSecurity Hall§f. Better not keep her waiting! §8(§7x§r2§8)
[04:47:57] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fHey, recruit!
[04:47:59] [NPC] Brigette: §fCome this way.
[04:48:10] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fHere, take a seat.
[04:48:10] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fWelcome to the §bSecurity Hall§f. It's the place for all safety matters.
[04:48:15] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fI believe §dElizabeth§f has already introduced you to what we do.
[04:48:19] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThe goal of the Safety Squad is to keep SkyBlock safe, and it starts with §c§lyou§f§f.
[04:48:24] Select an option: [Who, me?]
[04:48:25] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fYes, you!
[04:48:26] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fIf everyone is aware of the importance of safety, the number of safety-related incidents would greatly decrease.
[04:48:33] Select an option: [What is a safety-related incident anyway?]
[04:48:35] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fI'm glad you asked.
[04:48:37] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fOn one hand, it is very §6§oimportant §f§fto do things to keep yourself as safe as possible.
[04:48:43] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fStay indoors when there's a thunderstorm, wear a safety hat while at a construction site, washing your hands frequently while in a hospital...
[04:48:51] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThese are all examples of §d§ophysical§f§f safety.
[04:48:54] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fToday, however, we will be focused on something that's §oalso§f very important.
[04:48:59] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThat being - §c§lAccount Safety§f§f.
[04:49:01] Select an option: [What's the point of Account Safety?]
[04:49:02] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fImagine logging in to SkyBlock and finding that all your belongings have disappeared.
[04:49:07] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fOr even worse, trying to log into your Minecraft account but finding yourself locked out.
[04:49:14] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThe point of §c§lAccount Safety§f§f is to prevent this from happening.
[04:49:18] Select an option: [I don't want to lose my account!]
[04:49:21] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fAnd that's why you should pay close attention to today's briefing.
[04:49:25] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fSkyBlock has a lot of players.
[04:49:28] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fYou will meet a lot of them throughout playing SkyBlock.
[04:49:32] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fYou could even make some very good friends!
[04:49:35] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fHowever, not everyone is here to make friends.
[04:49:38] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fSome of them are here to steal your coins, items, or even your account!
[04:49:43] Select an option: [That doesn't sound good.]
[04:49:56] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fOf course it doesn't.
[04:49:58] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fRule number 1, never trust §ostrangers §fon the internet.
[04:50:02] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fStrangers are people you just met. You §c§ldon't know§f §fwho they are.
[04:50:06] Select an option: [Stranger danger, understood.]
[04:50:10] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fIf someone approaches you, they very likely want §osomething §ffrom you.
[04:50:15] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fWhat looks like a seemingly innocent request could lead to you §c§llosing your account§f.
[04:50:20] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThe most common way to lose your account is by opening §c§lsuspicious§f links.
[04:50:24] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fIf someone sends a link in chat, chances are they are trying to §c§lsteal§f your account.
[04:50:30] Select an option: [I'm not stupid enough to open a random link!]
[04:50:33] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fI'm sure you're not!
[04:50:35] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThe thing is, the evil people who steal accounts will try to catch you §e§loff guard§f.
[04:50:40] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThey try to make you open links in situations where it seems reasonable.
[04:50:44] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fOr situations where you're distracted, or least suspecting a §cscam§f.
[04:50:49] Select an option: [C'mon, I'm sure it's not thaaat complicated.]
[04:50:51] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fA way hackers can gain your trust is by messaging you from an account they've already hacked.
[04:50:57] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fIf it looks like your friend sent you that message, you'd be inclined to trust them more, right?
[04:51:03] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThen when you click the link they send you...
[04:51:04] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fJust like that, your account is gone.
[04:51:07] Select an option: [Brigette, you're quite scary.]
[04:51:09] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fScary I am indeed.
[04:51:11] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fBut losing your account is an even scarier proposition.
[04:51:15] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fAnyways.
[04:51:16] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fWe were talking about links, and how you should be very careful when clicking on links.
[04:51:22] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fIf you ever receive a §c§lsuspicious§f message in-game, you should report the player with the /report command.
[04:51:28] Select an option: [The /report command. Noted.]
[04:51:31] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThe dangers of clicking unverified links is not limited to within SkyBlock.
[04:51:36] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fIt's something that applies all over the internet, really.
[04:51:40] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThere are some situations where you may encounter suspicious links for SkyBlock outside of the game itself.
[04:51:47] Select an option: [Links for SkyBlock outside SkyBlock? Like what?]
[04:51:51] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fFor example, you may be trying to download a mod for SkyBlock.
[04:51:55] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fOr perhaps, you're linked a page to someone's SkyBlock profile, to check out their stats or something.
[04:52:01] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fWhile it's unlikely that these links are bad, you should be careful when clicking them, and try your best to verify whether they're trustworthy.
[04:52:09] Select an option: [I will be careful when clicking on links, I promise!]
[04:52:15] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThat's the spirit!
[04:52:17] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fYou're saying we got another recruit? That's great, I'll get them settled.
[04:52:22] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThanks, Salad!
[04:52:29] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fWell that's not good!
[04:52:31] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fI hope you both are okay.
[04:52:34] Select an option: [I'm good, thanks.]
[04:52:36] [NPC] Brigette: Sorry [Wither_101 head]Wither_101, I'll go grab a chair real quick, and get someone to clean up this mess.
[04:52:41] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fNew recruit, you may use my chair for now.
[04:52:44] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fBe right back!
[04:52:51] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fHi, the name's §9Jimmy§f.
[04:52:53] Select an option: [Hello, Jimmy.]
[04:52:57] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fThis place looks awesome. I'm all about security.
[04:53:00] Select an option: [Security is indeed very important.]
[04:53:03] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fI got these really cool gauntlets. It lets me fight against baddies.
[04:53:08] Select an option: [Cool.]
[04:53:14] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fYou don't look quite ready for a security job. Where's your gear, bro?
[04:53:18] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fSay, would you like to trade for my gauntlets?
[04:53:22] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fIt will allow you to punch well above your weight.
[04:53:25] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fFor the lowly price of §6999 coins§f, they can be yours.
[04:53:29] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fIf you're down for it, we can trade outside the §bSecurity Hall§f.
[04:53:33] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fDeal?
[04:53:34] Select an option: [Deal.]
[04:53:43] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fGreat, we're now besties!
[04:53:45] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§f§l§oSay, how did you end up here?
